When Is the Right Time to Outsource Your Product Design?

Let’s say you have an idea for a digital product and even got an in-house team. Yet, you’re still considering outsourcing. Here are typical scenarios where remote collaboration might work for your business:
Initial Stage of MVP Development

This scenario is great for startups with a development team but lacking a specialist to take care of the MVP’s visual part. Some businesses would engage a designer right away. However, hiring designer remotely is an ideal solution for startups where the scope of work is not always clear.
Product Redesign

Let’s imagine you already have a digital product, but you feel it needs a change. Even if your team has a skilled designer, a new perspective might be helpful when your project requires a redesign. In this case, UX/UI design outsourcing is perfect.
Your Internal Team Is Short on Resources and Capabilities

Before bringing your idea to life, determine whether your in-house team has the necessary skills and expertise. Designing your product takes in-depth analysis, proper documentation, prototyping, and direct production. If your employees lack experience in at least one of these areas, you should seek help from an outsourced digital product agency.
Design and Development Is Not Your Main Business

Non-IT businesses frequently require digital products as well. Relevant experience and knowledge are needed to create such solutions. Therefore, if the design is not your primary area of expertise, it is better to transfer this task to a qualified outsourcing digital design agency.
Tight Deadlines

Even if you have an in-house design team, it might simply lack the resources to handle your project deadlines. In such cases, you may need the help of a third-party company. You can delegate part of the product design responsibilities to speed up the implementation of your idea into reality.
Short-term Projects

Outsourcing design services will come in handy if you realize there will not be much design work on the project. In such a case, there is no point in hiring full-time employees if you know that their services will be unnecessary in a few months.
What Are the Common Mistakes When Outsourcing Product Design?
If your preference falls on outsourcing product design, make this choice correctly. Here are common mistakes to avoid when selecting a remote design company.
Choosing the Cheapest Services

Naturally, companies that outsource part of their responsibilities mainly pursue financial gain. Yet, it would help if you did not base your choice only on the lowest prices. You can run into a dishonest service provider that lacks the experience and skills to provide a high-quality product.
Searching Only for Local Companies

Don’t limit yourself to local talent. In the digital age, remote communication is smooth, and companies that provide outsourced design services have all the tools to make it effective. Furthermore, remote agencies often offer less expensive services than might be in your area.
Selecting a Team with a Limited Skillset or Expertise

Do you want outsourcing specialists to deliver you a decent design? Outlining your requirements and specifications should be the first step in choosing the right vendor. So make sure that the company you contact has the relevant experience and skills to realize your idea.
Neglecting Thorough Planning

Having a clear strategy is a must, especially when you outsource. The executor of your tasks must know what you require to avoid making mistakes in the project. Before a remote team starts designing your product, make sure you have a clear plan for this process.

You can expand your business’s efficiency by contacting a remote UI/UX design agency. You can engage workers for any period at the time when you need them most. It is much faster and more convenient than hiring in-house designers.

title: Peer to Peer Payment Apps: Process & Challenges
author: Vlad Gavriluk
excerpt: The technology advancements in the financial sector seem to be putting cash aside. The growing popularity of peer-to-peer payments in recent years only adds to this trend.

body.text: The technology advancements in the financial sector seem to be putting cash aside. The growing popularity of peer-to-peer payments in recent years only adds to this trend.

According to [eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/us-mobile-peer-to-peer-payments-forecast-2022), there are 148.8 million P2P mobile payment users in the US, almost 62% of the total smartphone users. The peer-to-peer payment sector will continue to grow, and in 2026, more than 180 million people will conduct P2P transactions.
The P2P payments market is steadily expanding. So if your plans include developing an application for peer-to-peer payments, you have every chance of achieving prosperity.

[Arounda](/) has prepared a detailed guide for building P2P payment apps for you. We’ll tell you about the main features you need to include in this application and review the main development stages.
Our team has applied best design practices to set over 250 products apart from others on the market.
But let’s first start with P2P payment apps
What Are Peer-to-Peer Payment Apps?

To understand P2P payment apps, you should first learn what peer-to-peer payments mean. These are electronic transactions where funds are transferred directly from one account to another. Accordingly, certain online platforms or applications are required to make such payments.

If you are familiar with the expression “I’ll Venmo you,” you have already encountered P2P payment applications in your everyday life. If not, we will explain everything to you now. So, these are platforms like Venmo or PayPal. How do they work?

To start making peer-to-peer transfers, you’ll need to create an account in the app and link your credit card or bank account to it. You can send money to other people using their email, phone number, or username.

The main advantage of peer-to-peer payment apps is the relatively low fees because you make transfers without intermediaries. P2P transfers are not limited to sending money to your friends. With such applications, you can pay for services, make online purchases, transfer abroad, and more.
Fundamental Features of P2P Payment Apps
You have complete freedom in choosing features for your P2P FinTech app. Yet, some functionality is mandatory for such applications. Here are all the must-have features:
Digital Wallet

Of course, an online payments app requires a digital wallet. There your users will store their funds and make transactions. Make sure to integrate several payment gateways and payment systems like Visa and Mastercard.
Send and Request Money
This feature is directly responsible for transfers in your app. Also, add an option to request money from other users.
Send Invoices and Bills
Your application won’t be complete if it lacks the function of generating and sending invoices. It is also a good idea to be able to send bills.
Transfer to a Bank Account
This feature gives more freedom to your users in payment methods. Let your app’s customers not only be able to transfer money from one card to another but also to a bank account.
Currency Conversion

People often use P2P payment apps for cross-border transfers. So here, it would help if you thought about adding a currency conversion feature. With it, your application automatically synchronizes with the exchange rate at the time of the user’s transaction.
Transaction History

This feature will allow users to monitor the funds they receive and send and track their expenses. It would be good if your app kept the transaction information as long as possible. Viewing or printing transaction statements for the month/year is also a useful feature.
Security

Security is of utmost importance when discussing any financial app, including the one for P2P payments. To make your application secure, you can implement the features of one-time passwords or IDs, two-factor authentication, and face or touch ID.
Push Notifications

Such notifications will pop up on your users’ screens as soon as there is some activity in the application: for example, crediting funds. This feature will also be helpful for you as you can send notifications about available promotions, offers, or updates in your app.
Customer Support Chat
Please do not neglect this feature for your financial app because instant problem solving for your users equals increasing their level of trust and loyalty to your application.

These were just fundamental features for your peer-to-peer payment app. Advanced functionality may include gamification, the ability to pay with cryptocurrencies, or a wealth management option. You can increase the number of your app’s features according to your needs and your audience’s requirements.
Arounda’s Experience in Working on P2P Apps
We are a team with extensive experience in the FinTech industry. First of all, we specialize in providing advanced Product Design.

How to Develop the Peer-to-Peer Application?
Knowing the main features of P2P apps, you can move on to the next step: developing such a product. To do this, you will need to go through several stages. Which ones exactly? Let’s figure them out.
1. Choose Peer-to-Peer Application Type
P2P payment apps are divided into several types. Here are two main ones:

title: How to Develop a Digital Banking Platform
author: Andrii Medintsev
excerpt: As the traditional financial system actively adopts technology, cash inevitably becomes outdated. We’ve seen solutions like Apple and Google Pay, smart contracts, and cryptocurrency emerging in recent years. The popularity of cashless payme

body.text: As the traditional financial system actively adopts technology, cash inevitably becomes outdated. We’ve seen solutions like Apple and Google Pay, smart contracts, and cryptocurrency emerging in recent years. The popularity of cashless payments is rising. So, banks have no other choice but to consider the innovation and digitization of their services.

There are an increasing number of convenient banking apps on the market, which are very much to the liking of modern users. Statista [says](https://www.statista.com/statistics/946109/digital-banking-users-usa/) more than 65% of Americans already use digital banking services. But the highest adoption level of online banking is in the Asian market, with more than 800 million active users.

Such demand for cashless payments resulted in the rapid growth of digital banking. If in 2025 this market amounted to [$11.56 billion](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/digital-banking-platform-market#:~:text=Digital%20Banking%20Platform%20Market%20Analysis,period%20(2025%2D2030).), by 2030, it will reach $22.30 billion. It is an annual increase of over 14%!
As banking platforms continue to be popular with users, creating such software is a promising endeavor. So how do you build one?

During 9+ years, our [Arounda team](https://arounda.agency/about) has designed modern, human-centered, and intuitive Fintech solutions. So, this article will be a guide to creating a digital banking platform. We will use our practical knowledge in creating the mentioned products to make this guide as informative as possible.
We’ll also explain what a digital bank and banking platform are, discuss their types and features, and show you some of the best examples of banking software available on the market.
What Is a Digital Banking Platform?
We’ll be talking a lot about digital banks and digital banking platforms. Let’s go over these concepts one by one.

A digital bank is an organization that provides online banking services. Simply put, this is when a traditional bank undergoes a digital transformation to extend its services to Internet users. That is, digital banks are largely dependent on traditional ones.
**They provide users with the following functions:**

items: Money deposits, withdrawals, and transfers
Account management
Credit management
Bills or invoices payments
Accounting services

body.text: A digital banking platform is a broad concept that refers to software that allows users to conduct financial operations online. Their main benefit is keeping all customer data in a single system.
**There are two main types of software for digital banking:**

items: Online banking software is a web-based platform for delivering financial services.
Mobile banking software is a mobile banking app that enables users to access financial services via their smartphones.

body.text: We also want to highlight neobanks. These solutions are one of the main trends in financial technology. The neobanking market is set to skyrocket from [$210.16 billion in 2025](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/neobanking-market-109076) to a massive $3.4 trillion by 2032. That’s nearly 49% growth every year, showing just how quickly digital banking is changing the financial world.

Neobanks are Fintech organizations that offer mobile or web applications for online banking only. That is, unlike digital banks, they do not have physical bank branches. They are also called internet-only banks.
Main Features and Challenges of Digital Banking Platform Development
No matter what digital banking software you want to create, whether it’s a money transfer app, a bank app, or another FinTech platform, you should consider the following **features:**
Payments

How can a digital banking platform exist without a payment function? It is the core banking app feature. Integrate all possible payment systems into your platform, and don’t forget about QR code payments for mobile users.

By embedding a built-in [QR code generator](https://www.adobe.com/express/feature/image/qr-code-generator), banks can let customers instantly create secure payment codes for fast, contactless transactions.
Quick and Secure Signup

Make registration on your platform as easy and secure as possible for users. For example, you can reduce the data customers must submit when creating an account. At the same time, take care of security features such as verification or security alerts.
User Verification

The security of banking platforms is of utmost importance. Therefore, adding a user verification feature would be a good idea. You can do this through biometric technologies such as Face-ID or fingerprint verification. Also, add the option of two-factor authentication.
Balance and Transaction Management
Adding users’ transaction history and bank account balance to your digital banking platform is a good idea. This way, users can keep track of where their money is going.
Push Notifications
Keep your platform users up to date with all the changes in their bank accounts. Thanks to push notifications, this becomes possible.
Activity Monitoring
Another feature that is also popular in finance apps is activity tracking. Thanks to it, your users will keep track of expenses, plan future investments, or manage their savings.
Card Management
Give your users the ability to manage their bank cards. In particular, allow your customers to open/block the card or change the PIN code.
Customer Support
The round-the-clock customer support function is mandatory for digital banking platforms. Thanks to it, your users can get help with financial matters anytime.
**Additional features** for your digital banking platform may include:
Cashback
This feature allows users to receive a percentage of money from each purchase.
Find ATM
With this feature, your users can find the nearest ATM on the map.
Personalization
This feature has a variety of uses. For example, you can allow users to change the application’s look: background color, font size, etc. Or you can add special offers for each customer.
Referral Program
This feature will allow your customers to receive bonuses or rewards for inviting new users through the referral program.
Accessing More Financial Products
This feature involves giving your users access to financial products such as loans or insurance.
Now let’s look at the main **challenges** you may encounter when developing your banking as a service platform.
Obtaining a Banking License

Before you can even start developing a digital banking platform, you need to get permission to deliver financial services. To obtain such a license, you will need to go through many legal inspections and provide a detailed business plan with information about all stakeholders in your company.
Regulatory Compliance
When developing a platform for online banking, you will need to consider the laws of your country or region. These laws concern data privacy and user protection.
Data Security

The digital banking platform is a big responsibility since users trust you with their sensitive personal data. Therefore, another challenge in the development will be to create a product that meets the highest safety standards.
Best Examples of Digital Banking Platforms
We believe that you must study your competitors well to create your own BaaS platform. So let’s learn from their best and discover more about the top digital banking platforms.
Chime
Chime is a FinTech company founded in San Francisco in 2013. It positions itself as an alternative to traditional banking and provides free mobile financial services.

Chime does not charge an overdraft fee, does not demand a monthly maintenance fee, and does not require a minimum balance. This mobile application offers secure transactions, a credit history builder, and automated savings. The Chime platform is in high demand among American users.
Monzo

Monzo is a British neobank founded in 2015. The platform currently has over [5 million](https://monzo.com) users. Monzo offers such features as budget management, savings, abroad transactions without commissions, instant notifications, and advanced security features.
Revolut
Revolut is a FinTech online banking company headquartered in London. Like Monzo, this company is an internet-only bank.

Among the features offered by Revolut are currency exchange, stock and cryptocurrency trading, and low exchange fees. The application can currently use crypto like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, XRP, and 29 fiat currencies.
How to Create a Digital Banking Platform?
Now let’s look at building a digital banking platform from scratch. To set up this process, you will need to go through several stages:
Stage 1. Market Research

In this step, you need to study your target audience and competitors. As a result, you can choose the best features and technologies for your platform, ensuring that your customers are satisfied and that you stand out in the market.
Stage 2. Planning
Once you have studied the market and analyzed the results of your research, you can begin to create a strategy for growing your business. So, at this stage, you need to develop a business plan.
Stage 3. UI/UX and Prototype
The main requirements of this stage are to create a user interface and provide user-friendly navigation on your open banking platform. As a result, you will have a ready-made prototype.
Stage 4. Security

At this stage, your team should take care of your banking platform’s security and consider what measures to take to provide it. For example, this could be data encryption or two-factor authentication.
Stage 5. Development

In this step, your developers begin to build your digital banking platform. They will develop an MVP at the end of this stage. Your team must also implement the third-party integrations required for your product.
Stage 6. Market Launch
This step involves launching your digital banking platform. Here, your team analyzes users’ acceptance of your product and thinks about improving it.
Stage 7. Improvement
It is the final and never-ending stage. Here you need to implement updates to your platform, offer new features, or improve existing ones.
Final Thoughts

Finance apps are gaining popularity due to the digital transformation of the traditional banking system. Online banking sees a steady influx of customers and tries to offer them user-friendly mobile and web solutions.

Creating platforms for online banking is a promising but challenging idea. Here you need to take care not only of software development but also of various legal issues. If you need someone to take on these tasks, you are in the right place.

Our team is ready to create a platform for digital banking for you using our profound experience in the field of FinTech. **So, if you are interested in our offer, feel free to **[**contact us**](https://arounda.agency/contact?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=how-to-develop-a-digital-banking-platform)** anytime.**

title: Personal Finance Apps: Best Design Practices
author: Valeriia Serohina
excerpt: The era of using Microsoft Excel spreadsheets for money management is fading away as more and more finance apps become available. Over [75%](https://www.factmr.com/report/personal-finance-mobile-app-market) of smartphone users surveyed by F

body.text: The era of using Microsoft Excel spreadsheets for money management is fading away as more and more finance apps become available. Over [75%](https://www.factmr.com/report/personal-finance-mobile-app-market) of smartphone users surveyed by Fact.MR stated they used at least one application to handle their finances.

According to the same survey, [6 out of 10](https://www.factmr.com/report/personal-finance-mobile-app-market) users prefer mobile personal finance apps over websites. It makes sense indeed. Such applications, if well-designed, make the budget management process more convenient (the smartphone is always close at hand) and less complex (most apps include simple wealth management tools).

But how to create such a financial application that will be user-friendly and as straightforward as possible? At Arounda, we know that the answer lies in flawless [UI/UX design](/services/ui-ux-design) and rich functionality.

In this article, we’d like to concentrate on the design of money management software. Arounda will use its experience in developing FinTech solutions, notably our product [Freedom Stocks](https://freedomstocks.com), to do this. We are experts in financial technologies dealing with various startups and established businesses in this sector.
What Are Personal Finance Apps?

A **personal finance application** is a software that helps people keep track of their money. Users can, for example, split cash flows, manage expenses, set financial goals, and more. Best personal finance apps offer even more functionality. It includes syncing with other users’ accounts or helpful tips for managing their money and investments.
Wealth management solutions like the Mint budget app allow users to:

items: View all their transactions
Check their balance
Track expenses and revenues
Set financial goals and achieve them
Save money
Adjust their financial behavior

body.text: As you can see, such applications offer users many benefits due to various money management tools. Yet, no matter how rich the app’s functionality, it is ineffective if the application’s design lags in quality. Continue reading to learn more about the importance of design in budgeting apps.
Why Is Design Essential for Financial Apps?
Should you pay close attention to the design of your finance application? Our experience proves that you should. Here’s just a couple of reasons for that.
Trust and Credibility

The visual component of your application significantly affects the level of trust among users. Imagine if the budget app was full of oversaturated colors and a load of information blocks. Would you like to entrust your confidential financial data to such an application? That’s it.

Design plays a critical role in familiarizing the user with your app. You increase your users’ trust by giving your product a nice look and easy navigation. And trust, in turn, is the first step to building long-term relationships between your customers and your application.
Simplicity and Actionability

According to [Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/259329/ios-and-android-app-user-retention-rate/), the retention rate for finance apps reaches 21.8% on the first day of use. But in 30 days, this percentage drops to 6.1%. Why does it happen?

We suppose the issue stems from the following fact: the already complicated finance industry adds to the complexity of its software solutions. Sophisticated design overloaded with numerous tools can confuse the average user of a FinTech app.
As a result, another critical reason to work on your app’s design is to ensure simplicity of use and retain more users.
Features for Your User
You may feel compelled to include as many innovative features as possible to stand out in the competitive FinTech apps market. But if you go overboard, you risk losing your users.

Decent work on your app’s design means studying the needs of your audience. With the right approach, you will determine which features your application needs and which are not so significant. The same goes for your product’s overall look.
We are not implying that innovative design and unique features are undesirable. But consider your users’ needs first because a well-thought-out UI/UX means a satisfied customer.
Easy Language
Numerous financial terms and tools are another critical reason to consider your money management software design. Quality design involves working on your app’s language.
With a comprehensive approach, you will explain complex financial terms in simple words and give your users some helpful tips. It will make using your application more convenient and enjoyable.
User-friendly Navigation

It is the design that makes using your finance software straightforward. Only by analyzing user experience will you be able to make the UI clear to your customers. You will retain more users, and they will utilize more features of your app if you make the navigation user-friendly.
Best Design Practices for Budgeting Apps
Let’s see how you can make the most of your finance app. Take a look at the best design practices for such applications.
Use Minimalistic Approach

Financial applications are all about numerous tools, features, and design elements. But a decent budgeting app is minimalistic: from colors and shapes to structuring information. So be careful not to overload your product with unnecessary details.
Provide Meaningful Content

We recommend you consider what your audience expects from your product and decide what features to provide. It doesn’t matter how fantastic your app’s functionalities are if they don’t add value to your user. For example, dashboards giving information about your customer’s finances will be valuable from a design standpoint.

Look at our [Freedom Stocks](https://freedomstocks.com) product, a website that delivers practical information on finances. We have made this resource as informative as possible for users, providing research reports and education materials on a personal budget, stocks, crypto, commodities, and taxes.
Add Goals

The budget monitoring feature in your application is only a starting point. Add goals and tasks to keep your users engaged in your app. As a result, your product will meet your customers’ needs in achieving their financial goals and simultaneously increase their time in your application.
Add Animations
If you think animation is not for finance apps, then we hasten to convince you otherwise. Interactive or animated elements add a bit of entertainment to your formal application.
Consider the Colors You Choose

Colors play a significant role in money management applications. Therefore, it would be best to give your application a serious vibe by choosing green, blue, and white colors. Of course, you can also use vivid colors but do it where appropriate.
Allow Customization

The loyalty of your users will increase if you allow them to customize the application according to their needs. It will be good to add the ability to add and alter budget categories or change spending limits.
How to Create a Finance App?
Let’s look at the process of creating a financial planning application. Here are the essential steps:
Step 1. Idea Discovery and Market Research

This step involves studying the audience that may be interested in your financial application. The team examines what strengths your software has and what its limitations may be. At this stage, business analysts are also analyzing your competitors.
Step 2. Design

This process entails developing a design layout for your finance software. Our specialists come up with user experience and create information architecture. Also, the team prepares mood boards and concepts, tests the UI, and makes adaptive product versions.
Step 3. Development
Developers, in addition to designers, start working at this point. They build the minimum viable product (MVP) for your finance app.
Step 4. Testing
Your application is almost ready to go live at this stage. But testers check it for flaws and bugs to bring your product to perfection.
Step 5. Market Launch and Further Support
Once you have made your finance application ideal, you can launch it on the market. Over time, you can improve your product by adding new features or changing design elements.

For example, look at how our team has improved [Gigzi’s](https://arounda.agency/case/gigzi) innovative financial system. During the audit, we found that this wealth management platform lacked decent graphics, branding, and UI/UX.

As a result, we created a new interface for the landing pages with an impeccable user experience. Our designers have also developed a fresh branding strategy for Gigzi. Among the innovative features that our team worked on are the crypto wallet and ICO cabinet.
Final Thoughts

Personal finance apps are growing in popularity, and their success in the market significantly depends on the design quality. Through design, you can give your users what they so desperately need. The ease of use and meaningful features help your customers solve their budgeting issues.

If your goal is to create such practical and successful finance applications, pay attention to their design. And if you need someone to implement your idea for a money management solution, then you are in the right place.

Arounda agency knows how to make high-quality finance software. Our Freedom Stocks and Gigzi products serve as an example. Feel free to [contact us](https://arounda.agency/contact?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=personal-finance-apps-best-design-practices), and let’s create a flawless design for your finance app!

author: Valeriia Serohina
excerpt: The global cryptocurrency market is expected to cost [$32,4 billion](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/global-cryptocurrency-market-report-2022-120800380.html) by 2027, with a [60%](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/global-cryptocurrency-market-r

body.text: The global cryptocurrency market is expected to cost [$32,4 billion](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/global-cryptocurrency-market-report-2022-120800380.html) by 2027, with a [60%](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/global-cryptocurrency-market-report-2022-120800380.html) annual growth rate! So it’s no surprise that crypto trading platforms are gathering steam.

Yet, the rising interest in crypto has highlighted this industry’s software issues. The entry threshold to almost any trading platform remains rather high. Such platforms primarily focus on advanced technologies while often overlooking their users. As a result, they target only a tech-savvy audience.

Crypto adoption has posed a new challenge for trading app owners: providing a consistent user experience. After all, only a straightforward and user-friendly application will be able to attract a wider audience.

Today, we’ll tell you why UI/UX is so crucial for trading platforms. [Arounda](/) has already designed blockchain products like [Astra](https://arounda.agency/case/astra), [Infinity](https://arounda.agency/case/infinity) or [MYSO](https://arounda.agency/case/myso). Our team has masterfully blended advanced technology and first-class UI/UX in these platforms.
Continue reading to learn about common challenges, benefits, and reasons to improve the user experience of crypto trading apps.
Reasons to Consider Redesigning Your Trading App

You may think of your trading application as something sophisticated and flawless. But for some reason, users are reluctant to use it or even leave your platform. So let’s see why you should think about redesigning your app.
Attract Non-techies

The сrypto industry attracts more and more newcomers daily. Typically, those are people who seek new opportunities to earn money. An average person is unlikely to use a complicated crypto trading app and will find a more user-friendly alternative on the market.
Gain Audience Loyalty
Improving the user experience and creating user-friendly interfaces are good signs for your audience. When users see you care about them, they become more loyal to your trading or investment app.
Be One Step Ahead

The crypto application market is vast. For example, there are [259](https://www.cryptimi.com/guides/how-many-cryptocurrency-exchanges-are-there) cryptocurrency exchanges like Binance. So, you’ll need a solid tech foundation and an appealing UI/UX to stand out.
Traders Get Younger and Their App Expectations Get Higher

Investing and trading used to be popular among the older generations. However, times have dramatically changed. According to research by [Investopedia](https://www.analyticsinsight.net/why-have-millennials-given-up-on-homes-in-exchange-for-crypto/), crypto is the most prevalent type of investment among millennials. These people, aged 26-41, have higher demands for the apps. Without a decent UI/UX, your FinTech product has no chance with the millennials.
Arounda’s Experience in Redesigning the FinTech App: BlocFX
We have extensive experience working with crypto projects and want to talk about one of them. So, meet BlocFX.

[BlocFX](https://www.dropbox.com/s/32xp5wk8q4o5w2s/_%E2%9C%85%20Arounda%20-%20Case%20Studies.pdf?dl=0) is an OTC platform that offers users the ability to buy foreign currency and make payments. This financial product includes a two-way exchange of cryptocurrency and fiat money. A personal profile, which allows users to add their bank accounts and wallets used during the exchange, transaction history, and OTC service are among the other features.
Our team helped create a strategy, UI/UX design, and development of the OTC platform. Let’s go through each step in more detail.
Strategy

At this stage, we have established the vision and mission of the product to determine what exactly will pique the users’ interest. Our team also analyzed the product, market, and audience, based on which we developed a robust strategy ready for implementation.
UI/UX Design

Our team started with the discovery stage, where we defined the design ideas following all best practices. We conducted user experience research and created the platform’s information architecture, developing a crypto UX design. After that, our designers made a user-friendly interface.
Development
Our team has fully developed the BlocFX web application, covering the frontend and backend.
Common UX Challenges with Online Trading Applications

[21%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/596462/biggest-problems-cryptoexchanges/) of traders complain about the crypto platforms’ inconvenient design. Yet, for some reason, such platform creators do not think about how to improve UI UX of their product. As a result, we see many intricate trading apps with an incomprehensible user experience.
**We have collected the main pain points in crypto UX.**
Onboarding

One challenge the crypto industry faces is that it’s difficult for users to get started with the application. The verification process is particularly troublesome, and it repels many people. The new audience may also find it problematic to understand how to use the app.
**Design tips: **conduct user research and ensure seamless platform navigation.
Transactions and Purchases

Another challenge the trading application’s owner faces is ensuring that the user understands how to use available financial instruments. The audience should have access to tutorials or tips on using financial features in the app, such as purchases, transactions, exchanges, and more.
Security and Privacy

Although a high level of security characterizes blockchain technology, there are still some problems with trading platforms. For example, such applications do not sufficiently inform their users about using and storing private and public keys, where to store the crypto better, etc.
Financial Statements

It may be challenging for new traders to comprehend the differences between particular tokens. Cryptocurrency prices vary on each platform, which also applies to transaction fees. Due to the lack of detailed financial statements, users risk spending more than they earn.
What Are the Benefits of Crypto Trading Platforms UI/UX Redesign?
If you decide to revise the crypto UI design and work on the user experience, you will benefit significantly. Just consider the following advantages:
Improved Usability

By reconsidering your product design, you not only work on the appearance of your trading platform. Here you also pave the way for the user and identify points your team can improve. By removing the flaws from your app design, you get improved usability and a satisfied audience.
Increased Retention Rates
Your application’s convenient and clear design will make your audience willing to use it. By redesigning, you adjust your platform to the users’ needs and, as a result, get higher retention rates.
Improved Engagement

Think of redesigning your app as something user-centric. High-quality UI/UX can lead to higher engagement with your platform. As a result, the audience will use all the features offered by your app since they will understand them well.
Boosted Trust
Users do not rely on suspicious platforms with a broken UX design. Instead, they opt for something comprehensible and visually pleasing.
Improved Brand Image
The redesign will allow you to keep up with the trends. With the new UI/UX, you can improve your brand identity and make it relevant.
Bonus: Use Your Redesign for Promotion
Once you have redesigned your crypto application, you can promote it to users. It may even help you attract the audience that left your platform, as you will offer them a refreshed app.

Improving users’ trading experience through redesign is a good idea. There are many reasons for this: the opportunity to attract non-techies, gain your audience’s loyalty, and boost your competitiveness.
As a result, the updated UI/UX will greatly benefit you. You’ll get better user retention and engagement, improved usability and brand image, and increased trust.
Arounda can improve your trading application’s design for you. We engage with many businesses, from startups to large corporations, and we’re here to help you.

** If you need your trading platform redesign, feel free to **[**contact our team**](https://arounda.agency/contact?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=how-to-improve-trading-experience-for-users-in-2022)**.**

title: Digital Design Agency vs. Freelancer: Which One to Choose
author: Oleksii Kovalchuk
excerpt: Decided to outsource your product’s design? So, you’re probably torn between hiring a digital agency or a freelancer.

body.text: Decided to outsource your product’s design? So, you’re probably torn between hiring a digital agency or a freelancer.

As a business owner, you understand the significance of working only with experienced experts. And studies show that [79%](https://www.flexjobs.com/blog/post/what-is-a-flexible-job/) of such remote specialists want flexibility.

How do you determine the best strategy for streamlining your product’s design process? You probably want your employees’ productivity to remain constant and offer them the flexibility they desire. That’s something we’ll talk about today.

Arounda has prepared a handy guide outlining the difference between hiring an agency and a freelancer. Here we will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of these two approaches and give reasonable advice on choosing the one that suits your business best.
Working with an Individual Freelance Designer
Today, we will begin our guide by describing the features of cooperation with an individual designer. Let’s get down to business, starting with the basics.

What is a freelancer? It is an individual remote worker whom you can hire as needed. The responsibilities of a freelancer will depend on factors like skills, experience, and the specialist’s expert niche. It means that you have the freedom to choose a professional with particular skills or hire one who can perform various tasks.

A freelancer is a self-employed professional who is fully responsible for their work, workload, and service cost. This specialist can be hired for as little as a few hours per week to as much as full-time.

The number of freelancers is constantly growing every year. The Upwork [press release](https://www.upwork.com/press/releases/freelancing-in-america-2017) suggests that by 2027, almost half of the US workforce will be freelancers. Among all these individual specialists in the United States, about [129,359](https://www.zippia.com/freelance-designer-jobs/demographics/) are freelance designers.

Thus, the choice of individual remote workers is significant. And geography is no longer a critical factor in employing such specialists. Let’s see what the advantages and disadvantages of hiring freelancers are.
Advantages
Flexibility
Freelancers can tailor their schedules to your needs. Such workers may operate outside the standard work schedule, such as on weekends.
Specialized Skills
Freelancers are often those who have exceptional skills in a particular niche. So if you need a professional who will perform specific tasks, a freelancer will come in handy.
Cost-effective
Freelancers are probably the most profitable outsourcing option. You know the price for the employee’s specific services in advance and control the number of his working hours.
Disadvantages
Unavailability
Remember that a freelancer is a self-employed person. As a rule, such specialists work with several clients simultaneously. Because of this, freelance services may not always be available to you.
Reliability

The freelancer is an individual worker, and therefore the human factor plays a significant role here. Illness or other unforeseen personal circumstances can knock such an employee out of your standard workflow. Compensating for such a specialist’s temporary absence can be challenging.
Hard to Replace

If you have been working with a freelancer for some time, it is clear that he is well acquainted with your product. Thus, when this employee leaves your company, it won’t be easy to replace him. You will have to start working with another specialist from scratch.
Working with a Digital Design Agency
The second approach to opt for is working with a digital product agency. How do such agencies function?

These are established businesses with an internal team and an art director that engage with several clients simultaneously. The workforce differs per organization; however, if we’re talking about a digital product agency, the following professionals may be available: graphic and UI/UX designers, product managers, project managers, and business analysts.
These agencies, like freelancers, are outsourcing vendors. That is, you can find a contractor anywhere on the globe.
A digital design agency learns all your product’s features and is ready to provide long-term and post-project support. As a result, you get a remote team fully immersed in your project.
**Here is how the communication process takes place in our company:**
Now let’s look at digital design agencies’ main advantages and disadvantages.
Advantages
Highly Experienced Professionals
Instead of one freelancer, you get access to the expertise of an entire team. Every agency employee can use their strengths to make your project flawless.
Flexibility
An outsourcing agency is just as flexible as a freelancer. You determine the workload in advance and can change it to suit your needs.
Guaranteed Results
Digital agencies are businesses that value their reputation. They can also provide a portfolio and feedback from real clients so that you are confident in the successful collaboration on the project.
Post-project Support & Long-term Cooperation
Most agencies offer ongoing support for your project, which is crucial in a changing digital environment. Employees of such agencies will adjust your product following current needs and trends.
Moreover, digital agencies prefer long-term cooperation because this is how they stabilize their workload and grow. Therefore, it is your best choice if you are interested in long-term cooperation.
See other benefits of working with digital design agencies below.
Disadvantages
Higher Cost of Services

Compared to an individual employee, the services of a design agency will be more costly. However, this drawback is easily compensated since you can access a comprehensive working approach, get a guaranteed high-quality result, and hand off your project to a dedicated and experienced team.
Not Feasible, If Small Project’s Scope

Although agencies work with both startups and large companies, such cooperation might not suit you if your project’s scope is small. Nevertheless, the agency may see the potential to grow your project into a bigger and more scalable product.
Freelancer vs. Agency: The Main Differences
It can be challenging to choose between a freelancer or a digital agency, even knowing the advantages and disadvantages of each approach. So let’s compare these two approaches for better clarity.
Skills and Experience
Freelancers usually specialize in a particular niche or specific tasks. Working with the agency, you have access to a team of qualified experts with the ability to create a product from scratch.
Services Quality

Freelancers work well with specific, niche tasks. Even if you hire a diligent and responsible worker, you should understand that this is an individual employee. Accordingly, such a specialist can not take care of all your product’s design tasks.
You get access to a wide range of quality services in digital agencies since such companies care about their reputation and have extensive experience working with different clients.
Price
Hiring freelance designers is cheaper than a digital agency if you have a small scope of work.
Flexibility

Both freelancers and digital agencies offer flexibility in collaboration. It all depends on the work schedule. Freelancers usually do not have a stable schedule, while digital agencies work according to a standard schedule. However, it all depends on the specific contractor.
How to Make the Best Choice for the Business?
If you are still hesitant about which one to choose: digital agency or freelancer, here are some points to consider:

items: **Does the contractor have experience in my niche?**

body.text: Carefully research the portfolio of your potential candidate. It is your best choice if a freelancer or digital agency has worked in your field and has shown successful results.

items: **Can the contractor prove his high efficiency?**

body.text: Ask a freelancer or digital agency to provide you with information about their effectiveness. Further, judging by the information received, you can conclude the need for cooperation with such a contractor.

items: **What is the general feedback on the contractor’s work?**

body.text: Study the reviews of real clients of a freelancer or digital agency. Look for feedback on their personal websites and forums or other platforms.
Both outsourcing approaches, such as hiring freelancers or digital agencies, have their particular pros and cons. When choosing, you need to start with the specific needs of your business.

If your goal is long-term cooperation, support, and guaranteed high-quality results, then a digital agency is your best choice. Just a few of our services include product strategy, business analysis, UX audit, UI/UX design, and brand identity.
